name: Kajiwara Kagetoki
source:
Magistrate of the Genji army.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Byakko of Earth.
An Onmyouji who uses the cosmic forces as well as tools that are like a gun.
He's a retainer of Minamoto no Yoritomo, as well as the big brother of the Black Dragon Priestess Kajiwara Saku.
He has a chill personality and seems like a reliable person.
He's a person who highly values peace.
